bits.label: Filing system
bits.description: The DNFS ROM starts in the network filing system when this link is made and in the disc filing system when it is open; the MOS does not read it, and other ROMs may.

bits.label: Not used

bits.label: Disc timing (link 3)
bits.description: With link 4, sets the disc drive step and settle times; the times depend on the disc controller and the filing system ROM fitted.

bits.label: Disc timing (link 4)

bits.label: SHIFT+BREAK action

bits.label: Screen mode bit 2

bits.label: Screen mode bit 1

bits.label: Screen mode bit 0
bits.description: Bit 0 of the screen mode the MOS selects at power-up and after BREAK.

options.description: Standard Acorn disc controller upgrade for BBC Model B

attachment_points.description: The 1 MHz bus, the expansion connector for add-ons such as a SCSI host adapter.
The user port, a parallel connector for add-ons such as a real-time clock.
The parallel printer port, a Centronics connector for a printer.
The Tube connector, which takes a second processor.
The RS423 serial port, for modems, printers and other computers.
The SCSI bus of a host adapter, which holds up to seven hard discs.

catalogue.name: aun
catalogue.description: Connects the Econet port to other machines over the network using AUN (Acorn Universal Networking).

parameters.label: UDP port
parameters.description: The UDP port this machine listens on for other AUN stations. Real AUN machines use 32768; several Beebium instances on one computer each need a different port. 0 lets the computer choose one, and 'none' keeps this machine off the network.

parameters.label: Net number
parameters.description: The Econet net this machine is on. Leave it at 0 unless it joins an AUN network whose nets are numbered.

parameters.label: Peers
parameters.description: The stations this machine can reach over AUN, each with the address and port of the computer that runs it. Stations found by discovery and those in the map file need no entry here.

fields.label: Econet net
fields.description: The Econet net the station is on. Net 0 means this machine's own net.

fields.label: Econet station
fields.description: The station's number on its net, from 1 to 254; 254 is the usual file server.

fields.label: AUN host (IP address or name)
fields.description: The IPv4 address or DNS name of the computer running the AUN station. A name is looked up on the computer running this emulator; one that does not resolve shows the peer as unreachable.

fields.label: AUN UDP port
fields.description: The UDP port the station listens on. Real AUN machines and bridges use 32768. Several Beebium instances on one computer each need a different port.

parameters.label: Subnet rules
parameters.description: Econet nets that are whole IPv4 subnets, as RISC OS machines on AUN arrange them: each computer on the subnet is a station of the net, numbered by the last part of its address and reached on port 32768.

fields.label: Econet net
fields.description: The Econet net number this subnet stands for. AUN convention numbers these from 128 upwards; net 0 is this machine's own net and cannot be a subnet rule.

fields.label: IPv4 subnet (a.b.c.0/24)
fields.description: The subnet whose addresses are the stations of this net: the machine at a.b.c.40 is station 40.

parameters.label: Map file
parameters.description: The file of AUN stations shared by every Beebium instance on this computer, which the Network sidebar edits. 'none' uses no map file.

parameters.label: Discovery
parameters.description: Whether this machine finds other Beebium machines on the local network, and lets them find it, by mDNS.

catalogue.name: host-serial
catalogue.description: Connects the serial port to a serial device or pseudo-terminal on this computer.

parameters.label: Mode
parameters.description: 'pty' (create a pseudo-terminal) or 'device' (open an existing serial/pty device path)

parameters.label: Path
parameters.description: pty: optional stable symlink to the pty slave; device: the serial device path to open

parameters.label: Baud rate
parameters.description: device line speed (ignored for pty)

parameters.label: Transmit buffer (bytes)
parameters.description: transmit buffer size in bytes; the BBC's /CTS asserts at/above it

catalogue.name: file-printer
catalogue.description: Spools everything the BBC sends to its printer port into a file on the host.

parameters.label: File
parameters.description: file to write; an existing file is replaced

parameters.label: Line ending
parameters.description: keep the bytes as sent, or translate the Beeb's CR line ends to LF or CR LF

parameters.label: Buffer (bytes)
parameters.description: receiver queue depth in bytes

catalogue.name: job-file-printer
catalogue.description: Writes what the BBC prints as one file per print job, a job ending after a quiet period.

parameters.label: Directory
parameters.description: directory to write job files into

parameters.label: Job ends after (seconds)
parameters.description: seconds of quiet, in emulated time, that end a job

parameters.label: Line ending
parameters.description: keep the bytes as sent, or translate the Beeb's CR line ends to LF or CR LF

parameters.label: Buffer (bytes)
parameters.description: receiver queue depth in bytes

catalogue.name: acorn-scsi
catalogue.description: The Acorn SCSI host adapter, which connects SCSI hard discs to the 1 MHz bus.

catalogue.name: rfc2217-server-serial
catalogue.description: Makes the serial port available to RFC 2217 clients elsewhere on the network.

parameters.label: Listen address
parameters.description: listen address; the service is UNAUTHENTICATED plain Telnet, so bind to a wider address only behind SSH/WireGuard

parameters.label: Listen port
parameters.description: TCP port to listen on

parameters.label: Transmit buffer (bytes)
parameters.description: transmit buffer size in bytes; the BBC's /CTS asserts at/above it

catalogue.name: rfc2217-client-serial
catalogue.description: Connects the serial port to a serial port server elsewhere on the network, using RFC 2217.

parameters.label: Server URL
parameters.description: Access-server endpoint as [scheme://]host:port (e.g. url="rfc2217://ser2net.local:4001"); alternative to host/port, cannot be combined with them

parameters.label: Server host
parameters.description: RFC 2217 access-server hostname or address (alternative to url)

parameters.label: Server port
parameters.description: RFC 2217 access-server TCP port (alternative to url)

parameters.label: Baud rate
parameters.description: baud rate to set on the remote UART (real hardware)

parameters.label: Framing
parameters.description: remote UART framing as <data><parity><stop> (data 5-8; parity N/O/E/M/S; stop 1/2), e.g. 8N1 or 7E1

parameters.label: Flow control
parameters.description: remote UART flow control: none, rtscts (hardware) or xonxoff

parameters.label: Assert DTR
parameters.description: assert DTR on the remote UART (many devices/modems need it; the BBC connector has no DTR pin)

parameters.label: Transmit buffer (bytes)
parameters.description: transmit buffer size in bytes; the BBC's /CTS asserts at/above it

catalogue.name: acorn-65c102-coprocessor
catalogue.description: An Acorn 65C102 Co-processor: a 4 MHz 65C102 with 64K of its own memory, connected through the Tube.

parameters.label: Client ROM
parameters.description: The Tube client ROM: a full 4 KB image of the 2732 (F000-FFFF), as a path, or the name of a ROM this co-processor ships

catalogue.name: hybrid-music-5000
catalogue.description: The Hybrid Music 5000 synthesiser, or its Music 3000 expander, which adds sixteen channels of digital sound on the 1 MHz bus.

parameters.label: Unit
parameters.description: Which board this is: the synthesiser itself, or the expander that adds a second set of channels.

choices.label: Music 5000 synthesiser
choices.description: Answers to JIM pages &30-&3F; its sound is audio field 2.

choices.label: Music 3000 expander
choices.description: Answers to JIM pages &50-&5F; its sound is audio field 3.

catalogue.name: tcp-printer
catalogue.description: Sends everything the BBC prints to a raw TCP printer port on the network, such as a JetDirect printer or a printer emulator.

parameters.label: Printer URL
parameters.description: Printer endpoint as [scheme://]host:port (e.g. url="socket://printer.local:9100"); alternative to host/port, cannot be combined with them

parameters.label: Printer host
parameters.description: Printer hostname or address (default localhost; alternative to url)

parameters.label: Printer port
parameters.description: Printer TCP port (default 9100, the JetDirect convention; alternative to url)

parameters.label: Buffer (bytes)
parameters.description: receiver queue depth in bytes; when it is full the BBC waits for /ACK

parameters.label: Reconnect interval (ms)
parameters.description: milliseconds between connection attempts while not connected; 0 makes one attempt and never retries

catalogue.name: acorn-65c02-coprocessor
catalogue.description: An Acorn 6502 Second Processor: a 3 MHz 65C02 with 64K of its own memory, connected through the Tube.

parameters.label: Client ROM
parameters.description: The Tube client ROM: a full 4 KB image of the 2732 (F000-FFFF), as a path, or the name of a ROM this co-processor ships

catalogue.name: host-parallel-printer
catalogue.description: Sends everything the BBC prints to a printer port on the host computer, such as /dev/usb/lp0 or LPT1.

parameters.label: Device
parameters.description: Host printer device: /dev/usb/lp0 or /dev/lp0 on Linux; on Windows a USB printer's \\?\usb#... interface path (HostParallelPrinter.ListDevices lists them) or LPTn, opened as \\.\LPTn

parameters.label: Buffer (bytes)
parameters.description: receiver queue depth in bytes; when it is full the BBC waits for /ACK

parameters.label: Reopen interval (ms)
parameters.description: milliseconds between attempts to open the device while it is not open; 0 makes one attempt and never retries

catalogue.name: loopback-serial
catalogue.description: Sends every byte the BBC transmits on its serial port straight back to it, for testing serial software.

catalogue.name: scsi-hard-disc
catalogue.description: A SCSI hard disc, kept in a pair of image files (.dat and .dsc).

parameters.label: SCSI ID
parameters.description: SCSI target ID (0-7)

parameters.label: Disc image
parameters.description: Path to DAT disc image file

parameters.label: SCSI adapter
parameters.description: ID of SCSI adapter to attach to

catalogue.name: acorn-rtc
catalogue.description: The Acorn real-time clock module, which plugs into the user port and keeps the date and time.

parameters.label: Start time
parameters.description: Set emulated clock to absolute datetime (e.g. 1985-03-15T10:30)

parameters.label: Offset from host time
parameters.description: Offset from host local time (e.g. -10y, +5h, -365d)

parameters.label: Register layout
parameters.description: How the file server software stores the year in the clock, which sets the years the clock can hold.

choices.label: Acorn original (4-bit year in R1)
choices.description: Years 1981 to 1996, as the original Acorn file servers expect. Not Y2K compliant.

choices.label: Level 3 File Server 1.26 (7-bit year in R7)
choices.description: Years 1981 to 2099, as the Level 3 File Server 1.26 expects.

choices.label: BeebMaster Y2KFIX (7-bit year in R1/R5)
choices.description: Years 1981 to 2108, as file servers patched with BeebMaster's Y2KFIX expect.

groups.label: Clock start
groups.description: Where the clock starts when the machine is switched on.

none.label: Host time
none.description: The clock follows this computer's clock.

catalogue.name: piconet
catalogue.description: Connects the Econet port to a real Econet network through a Piconet USB interface.

parameters.label: Device
parameters.description: The serial device of the Piconet bridge, for example /dev/cu.usbmodem101. 'auto' finds a connected Piconet.

catalogue.name: rpc-serial
catalogue.description: A serial peer that a client program drives, sending and receiving bytes through the RpcSerial service; used by automated tests.

parameters.label: Transmit buffer (bytes)
parameters.description: transmit buffer size in bytes; the BBC's /CTS asserts at/above it

catalogue.name: test-scratch-ram
catalogue.description: Eight bytes of scratch RAM at &FC50 on the 1 MHz bus, for testing the extension framework.

catalogue.name: ip232-serial
catalogue.description: Connects the serial port to an IP232 modem emulator, such as tcpser, over the network.

parameters.label: Server URL
parameters.description: IP232 server endpoint as [scheme://]host:port (e.g. url="ip232://bbs.example.com:25232"); alternative to host/port, cannot be combined with them

parameters.label: Server host
parameters.description: IP232 server hostname or address (default localhost; alternative to url)

parameters.label: Server port
parameters.description: IP232 server TCP port (default 25232; alternative to url)

parameters.label: Mode
parameters.description: 'ip232' (0xFF-escaped, persistent connection) or 'raw' (pure byte pipe, connect/disconnect on RTS)

parameters.label: Convey RTS
parameters.description: convey the BBC's RTS line to the server via the 0xFF escape (ip232 mode only)

parameters.label: Transmit buffer (bytes)
parameters.description: transmit buffer size in bytes; the BBC's /CTS asserts at/above it
